title: DGF-D11F / D11P / D11H - Deesys digital ground fault relay (GFR) with LCD, ZCT input
range_short_desc: Digital ground fault relay with LCD and fault memory, for low-voltage circuits
description: Deesys DGF-D11 series digital ground fault relay. Detects ground faults on both grounded and ungrounded systems through a zero-phase current transformer (ZCT), measuring the ZCT input precisely while rejecting harmonic components and noise. The ground-fault (leakage) status of each circuit is alarmed and shown on the LCD, and the fault current at the moment of the trip is stored so it can be read back for post-fault analysis. Free-voltage AC/DC 100–240 V control power, 1a output contact rated AC 250 V 10 A / DC 30 V 10 A, current tap LOCK and 0.1–10.0 A, definite-time operation from INST to 5.00 s, built to KS C 8328. Available vertical (D11F flush, D11P socket) and horizontal (D11H), with an optional RS-485 Modbus port on the -C models. Deesys specifies this relay for ground-fault protection of circuits below 600 V, so it pairs with the low-voltage DZR, DZS or SZR ZCTs — it is NOT the relay for the high-voltage HZR ZCT.

feature_groups.title: Main Feature
items: The ground fault (leakage) status of the electric line is alarmed and displayed for each circuit, and the ground fault current in the event of a ground fault is displayed on the LCD display
It stores the ground fault current value at the time of an accident and can be used as data for condition analysis after a fault
Built-in communication port enables remote monitoring (optional function)
Provides convenient HMI through key interface
Malfunction can be prevented against harmonic components and various noises

feature_groups.title: Voltage class
items: Deesys specifies this relay for protecting ground faults on circuits below 600 V
Pair with the low-voltage Deesys ZCTs: DZR (round cable-through), DZS (square busbar-through) or SZR
Not the relay for the high-voltage HZR ZCT (6,600 / 3,300 V), whose catalog specifies HGR / DGR relays

rows: Rated input : ZCT input AC 200 mA / 100 mV — models with an A suffix are AC 200 mA / 1.5 mA
Display : LCD display
Frequency : 60 Hz / 50 Hz
Control power : AC/DC 100 V ~ 240 V (free volt)
Consumption : standby less than 5 W, run less than 7 W
Output contact : 1a contact (AC 250 V 10 A, DC 30 V 10 A)
Communication : RS-485 Modbus — on the -C models only
Applicable standard : KS C 8328
Current TAP : LOCK, 0.1 ~ 10.0 A [0.1 A step]
Metering range : 0.01 ~ 12.5 A [abnormal current input shows OvC (over current)]
Operation range : within 75~100% of each correction value
Operating characteristic : definite time
Op. lever : INST ~ 5.00 sec [0.1 sec step]
Accuracy : INST ~ 0.20 sec within ±40 ms / 0.20 ~ 5.00 sec within ±10%
Return current : firmly returns at 90% of each correction value
Return time : INST / 0.1 ~ 30.0 sec (under 1 sec : 0.1 sec step, over 1 sec : 1 sec step)
Return method : auto (return time applied) / manual
Fault memory : when a fault current occurs the fault current value is displayed on the LCD; the latest fault current can be read back with the fault current check function
Fault recovery : LCD backlight and output contact [auto return setting possible]
Keypad : M (menu), ▲, ▼, SET, TEST, RESET
LCD backlight : off = RUN, green = normal, red = alarm
